title: Not too hot
objective: You are choosing a drink. Listen for temperature and size.

opening.en: Please give me another cup of tea.

ladder.en: The tea is hot.
The water is too cold.
I want a small cup.
This cup is too big.

transfers.en: This water is neither cold nor hot.
transfers.question: Is the water hot?
transfers.answer: No. It is neither cold nor hot.

transfers.zh: 我要小杯子，不要大杯子。
transfers.en: I want the small cup, not the big cup.
transfers.question: Which size does the speaker want?

dialogue.en: Would you like some tea?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Yes, but this tea is too hot.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogue.en: Would you like water?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Yes, please give me a small cup.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogueQuestion: Why did the visitor choose water?

title: Let some air in
objective: You are in a warm room. Listen for what to open and what to close.

ladder.en: The room is hot.
Please open the window.
Please close the door.
The door is closed and the window is open.

transfers.zh: 请打开门，不要打开窗户。
transfers.en: Please open the door, not the window.
transfers.question: What should you open?

transfers.en: The room is cold. Please close the window.
transfers.question: Why close the window?

dialogue.en: The room is too hot.
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: May I open the window?
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogue.en: Yes. Please close the door.
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Okay. The door is closed.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogueQuestion: What should happen to the window and the door?
dialogueAnswer: Open the window and close the door.

title: A place to sit
objective: You are visiting a friend. Listen for where you can sit.

ladder.en: There is a chair here.
Please sit down.
This sofa is comfortable.
I want to sit on the sofa.

transfers.en: He is standing beside the door.
transfers.question: Is he sitting?

transfers.zh: 椅子太小了，我想坐在沙发上。
transfers.en: The chair is too small. I want to sit on the sofa.
transfers.question: Why choose the sofa?

dialogue.en: Please sit. There is a chair here.
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: May I sit on the sofa?
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogue.en: Yes. The sofa is comfortable.
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Thank you. I would like some water.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogueQuestion: Where does the visitor want to sit?

closing.en: I want to sit on the sofa.
Please give me a cup of water.

title: Which shoes?
objective: You are getting dressed. Listen for the clothes and their colors.

opening.en: My key is in the pocket.

ladder.en: These are my shoes.
My socks are white.
I want to wear the black shoes.
The white shoes are too small.

transfers.zh: 他的鞋子是白色的，袜子是黑色的。
transfers.en: His shoes are white and his socks are black.
transfers.question: What color are his socks?

transfers.zh: 我不想穿这件外套，太热了。
transfers.en: I do not want to wear this coat. It is too hot.
transfers.question: Why does the speaker not want the coat?

dialogue.en: Do you want to wear the white shoes?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.zh: 不想，白色的鞋子太小了。
dialogue.en: No. The white shoes are too small.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogue.en: How about wearing the black shoes?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Okay. The black shoes are comfortable.
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogueQuestion: Which shoes will the speaker wear, and why?
dialogueAnswer: The black shoes. They are comfortable; the white shoes are too small.

closing.en: I want to wear the black shoes.

title: Before you go out
objective: You are going outside. Listen for what to take when it rains.

opening.en: I want to wear the black shoes.

ladder.en: It is raining outside.
Please take an umbrella.
My umbrella is beside the door.
It is cold outside. I want to come back now.

transfers.zh: 外面没有下雨，但是很冷。
transfers.en: It is not raining outside, but it is cold.
transfers.question: Is it raining?
transfers.answer: No. It is cold, but not raining.

transfers.en: I brought my key, but did not bring an umbrella.
transfers.question: What did the speaker leave behind?

dialogue.en: Is it raining outside?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Yes. Did you bring an umbrella?
dialogue.speaker: b

dialogue.en: No. Where is my umbrella?
dialogue.speaker: a

dialogue.en: Beside the door. Please take it with you.
dialogue.speaker: b

closing.en: My key is in the pocket.

title: Please Leave It at the Door
objective: Tell a delivery person where to leave your package.

ladder.en: I am not at home right now.
Please leave it at the door.

ladder.zh: 请放在门口的椅子上，不要放在地上。
ladder.en: Please leave it on the chair by the door, not on the ground.

title: Which Package Is Mine?
objective: Identify your package and check the name on it.

ladder.zh: 这个包裹上面有我的名字。
ladder.en: My name is on this package.
What name is written on it?
Yes, this one is mine.
This one is not mine.
My surname is Li.

title: Upstairs or Downstairs?
objective: Agree on where to meet the delivery person.

ladder.en: I am coming downstairs now.
Please wait for me beside the elevator.
I will go downstairs to collect the package.

ladder.zh: 我在楼下的门口，不在电梯旁边。
ladder.en: I am at the downstairs entrance, not beside the elevator.

title: Could You Say That Again?
objective: Slow a phone conversation down and check what you heard.

opening.en: Please speak a little more slowly.

ladder.en: Sorry, I did not hear clearly.
Please say it again.

ladder.zh: 您说得太快了，我没听清楚。
ladder.en: You spoke too quickly. I did not hear clearly.

ladder.zh: 您在楼下，不在楼上，对吗？
ladder.en: You are downstairs, not upstairs, correct?

title: Please Keep the Box Dry
objective: Ask for a dry place and describe a heavy package.

ladder.en: That small box is light.
The box has gotten wet.

ladder.zh: 请放在里面，不要放在外面。
ladder.en: Please put it inside, not outside.

ladder.zh: 大箱子湿了，小箱子还是干的。
ladder.en: The large box got wet; the small box is still dry.

ladder.zh: 请放在门里面的地上，谢谢。
ladder.en: Please put it on the floor just inside the door. Thank you.

title: The Missing Assignment
objective: Ask about an unfinished assignment and agree on a deadline.

ladder.en: Not yet.
When can you hand it in?
Please hand it to me tomorrow.
I finished it, but I have not handed it in yet.
Next time, do not hand it in late.

title: Make Your Meaning Clear
objective: Discuss an essay paragraph and ask for a clearer example.

ladder.en: Please give me an example.
This example is good.
Please revise this paragraph.
Now it is much clearer.

ladder.zh: 我可以写学校里的事情吗？
ladder.en: May I write about things at school?

title: Which Classroom?
objective: Find the classroom and check the lesson times with a colleague.

opening.en: Which classroom is the English lesson in?

ladder.en: The classroom is beside the office.
What time do we start class?
Class starts at three and finishes at four.

ladder.zh: 办公室在楼下，教室在楼上。
ladder.en: The office is downstairs and the classroom is upstairs.
After class, please come to the office.

title: A Conversation with a Parent
objective: Describe progress and agree on a practical way to help.

opening.zh: 您的孩子最近进步很大。
opening.en: Your child has made a lot of progress recently.

ladder.en: He now hands in assignments on time.
How can I help him?

ladder.zh: 请问问他，今天的作业完成了吗？
ladder.en: Please ask him whether today's assignment is finished.
Please remind him to hand it in on time.
I will help him too.

title: A Taxi to School, a Taxi Home
objective: Build and recall your school and home taxi destinations.

ladder.en: Huarun Twenty-Four City, phase four.

ladder.zh: 师傅，请到成都爱思瑟国际学校。
ladder.en: Driver, please take me to Chengdu Aisise International School.

ladder.zh: 师傅，请到华润二十四城四期。
ladder.en: Driver, please take me to Huarun Twenty-Four City, phase four.
Twenty-Four City, phase four, correct?
Yes, phase four.

title: Entering Royal Road
objective: Choose a skill and follow your first steps into Royal Road.

ladder.zh: 我有一个皇家之路的账号。
ladder.en: I have a Royal Road account.
I want to choose a skill.
Which skill do you want to choose?
Experience has increased.

ladder.zh: 我有账号，但是没有这个技能。
ladder.en: I have an account, but I do not have this skill.

title: Choosing Your Equipment
objective: Recognize weapons, shields, and armor as you prepare for a journey.

ladder.en: This weapon is sharp.
This shield is heavy.
Raise the shield.

ladder.zh: 这套盔甲是不是太重了？
ladder.en: Is this suit of armor too heavy?
He puts on armor and raises the shield.

title: The First Battle
objective: Listen for who attacks, dodges, and protects a friend.

ladder.en: The warrior launched an attack.
He dodged.
The warrior raised his shield.
He wants to protect his friend.
Do not attack yet.
Protect your friend first.

title: Finding the Camp
objective: Follow directions between a town, a valley, and a camp.

ladder.en: Where is the camp?
The camp is in the valley.
Walk toward the town.
He is in the town.
He is walking toward the town.

ladder.zh: 营地在山谷里，不在城镇里。
ladder.en: The camp is in the valley, not in the town.

title: A Hidden Clue
objective: Observe a room again and discover a hidden map.

ladder.en: Observe this room carefully.
Look at that corner.
A map is hidden in the corner.
Look again.

ladder.zh: 那个角落里藏着一条线索。
ladder.en: A clue is hidden in that corner.

title: Inside the Sculpting Shop
objective: Choose tools and materials for your first attempt at sculpting.

opening.en: He walked into the sculpting shop.

ladder.en: The tools are on the table.
I need some material.
This is clay.

ladder.zh: 这个工具可以切割木头。
ladder.en: This tool can cut wood.
I want to try using clay first.

title: Is It Worth the Money?
objective: Distinguish expensive items from precious ones and decide what is worth buying.

ladder.en: This material is expensive.
Is it worth buying?
It is expensive, but worth buying.
Do not waste materials.
I am reluctant to sell this weapon.

title: Resting After the Battle
objective: Understand injuries and the difference between resting and giving up.

opening.en: The priest is in the camp.

ladder.en: The warrior was injured.
You need to rest.
Rest first, then continue.

ladder.zh: 我想休息，但是不想放弃。
ladder.en: I want to rest, but I do not want to give up.
Do not give up.

title: Surprise and Relief
objective: Follow a narrator through contrast, consequences, surprise, and relief.

opening.en: He was tired, yet did not want to rest.

ladder.en: He was tired, so he sat down to rest.
The warrior froze in surprise.
He breathed a sigh of relief.
As it turned out, he found his friend.
He was injured, yet did not want to give up.

title: The Courage to Continue
objective: Understand even if, as long as, and unless as you bring the journey together.

ladder.en: That warrior has courage.
Even if it is difficult, I still want to try.

ladder.zh: 即使很累，我也不会放弃。
ladder.en: Even if I am tired, I will not give up.

ladder.zh: 只要有地图，我们就能找到营地。
ladder.en: As long as we have a map, we can find the camp.

ladder.zh: 除非下雨，否则我们明天出发。
ladder.en: Unless it rains, we will leave tomorrow.

ladder.zh: 勇气不一定让你成功，但是能让你再试一次。
ladder.en: Courage does not necessarily make you succeed, but it can help you try again.

title: The Account I Almost Deleted
objective: Weed remembers the game account he almost deleted. Short Chinese phrases are followed by English. Narrated by Office Man.

ladder.en: Delete account.

ladder.zh: 几个字，就能结束那么多年的努力。
ladder.en: A few words could end years of effort.

ladder.zh: 可那天晚上，我的手停住了。
ladder.en: But that night, my hand stopped.
My name is Lee Hyun.

ladder.zh: 在游戏里，大家叫我 Weed。
ladder.en: In the game, people call me Weed.
Back then, I had two worlds.

ladder.zh: 一个世界里，我什么都有。
ladder.en: In one, I had everything.

ladder.zh: 另一个世界里，奶奶连看病的钱都没有。
ladder.en: In the other, Grandmother couldn't afford a doctor.
When I came home, she was lying in bed.
She asked whether my sister was home.
I said, not yet.
She asked me to look after her.
I promised I would.
But a promise is easy.

ladder.zh: 买药的时候，人家要的不是答应。
ladder.en: At the pharmacy, promises aren't what they want.
They want money.

ladder.zh: 我回到房间，打开旧电脑。
ladder.en: I went to my room and started the old computer.
It was slow.

ladder.zh: 穷人的电脑，也懂得节省力气。
ladder.en: Even a poor man's computer saves its energy.

ladder.zh: 我等着，想起第二天的事。
ladder.en: I waited, thinking about tomorrow.
I needed a job.

ladder.zh: 还需要一身像样的衣服。
ladder.en: And some decent clothes.
The game opened.

ladder.zh: 那里有我的装备，我的成绩。
ladder.en: There was my equipment, everything I'd achieved.

ladder.zh: 我的等级，已经不能再高了。
ladder.en: My level couldn't go any higher.

ladder.zh: 再强的对手，我也打得过。
ladder.en: I could beat even the strongest opponents.

ladder.zh: 可是我看着屏幕，笑不出来。
ladder.en: But looking at the screen, I couldn't smile.

ladder.zh: 这些东西，能给奶奶买药吗？
ladder.en: Could any of this buy Grandmother medicine?
I was ready to delete my account.
From now on, I'd spend my time working.
The computer asked again.
Did I really want to delete it?
I stared at those words.
Wait.

ladder.zh: 有人买游戏账号，对不对？
ladder.en: People bought game accounts, didn't they?

ladder.zh: 那我为什么要白白扔掉？
ladder.en: Then why was I throwing mine away?
I found an auction site.

ladder.zh: 想看看别人的价格，竟然还要付钱。
ladder.en: Even checking other prices cost money.
Spend money before earning any?
I didn't like that beginning.

ladder.zh: 我把等级和装备展示出来。
ladder.en: I displayed my level and equipment.
Bidding started at fifty thousand won.
Just one day.

ladder.zh: 也许，够买找工作的衣服。
ladder.en: Perhaps it would buy clothes for job hunting.
Then I went to sleep.

ladder.zh: 我以为，只会有几个人看看。
ladder.en: I thought a few people might look.

ladder.zh: 后来才知道，我错得多厉害。
ladder.en: Later, I learned how wrong I was.

ladder.zh: 最后，买下账号的是一家媒体公司。
ladder.en: In the end, a media company bought the account.

ladder.zh: 价格是三十亿九千万韩元。
ladder.en: The price was three billion, ninety million won.
I looked once. Then again.

ladder.zh: 这么多零，真的不是看错了？
ladder.en: All those zeros. Was I seeing things?
I checked that the money had really arrived.

ladder.zh: 然后，把存折拿给奶奶看。
ladder.en: Then I showed Grandmother the bankbook.

ladder.zh: 那时候，我想到的不是好装备。
ladder.en: At that moment, I wasn't thinking about equipment.
I thought about a hospital. A home.

ladder.zh: 是妹妹以后可以去大学。
ladder.en: About my sister being able to attend university.

ladder.zh: 我们终于可以喘口气了。
ladder.en: At last, we could breathe.
Many hard things still lay ahead.

ladder.zh: 钱，并没有让所有问题消失。
ladder.en: Money didn't make every problem disappear.

ladder.zh: 但我一直记得那个晚上。
ladder.en: But I've always remembered that night.

ladder.zh: 我的手，停在删除按钮前。
ladder.en: My hand, resting before the delete button.

ladder.zh: 我本来想结束一个故事。
ladder.en: I'd meant to end a story.

ladder.zh: 没想到，给自己留下了一个开始。
ladder.en: Instead, I'd left myself a beginning.

title: One More Strike
objective: Weed remembers the training nobody understood. Short Chinese phrases are followed by English. Narrated by Weed.

ladder.zh: 你知道六个小时，可以做多少事吗？
ladder.en: Do you know how much you can do in six hours?
I did just one thing.

ladder.zh: 打一个不会还手的稻草人。
ladder.en: I hit a straw dummy that couldn't hit back.
Sounds like I chose my opponent well.

ladder.zh: 那是我刚进入王国之路的时候。
ladder.en: That was when I first entered Royal Road.
I arrived in Serabourg.
A new body. A new city.

ladder.zh: 连走路的感觉，都那么真实。
ladder.en: Even walking felt real.
I tried moving, then jumping.

ladder.zh: 别人看我的眼神，可不太友好。
ladder.en: The looks people gave me weren't very friendly.
Well, embarrassment was free.
I could afford that.

ladder.zh: 新手有四个星期，不能离开城市。
ladder.en: Beginners couldn't leave the city for four weeks.

ladder.zh: 别人可能觉得，这是等待。
ladder.en: Others might call that waiting.
I called it time.
And time mustn't be wasted.
So I went to the training hall.
The instructor set me to work.
I gripped my sword and faced the dummy.
One strike. Then another.

ladder.zh: 开始的时候，我还想着奖励。
ladder.en: At first, I thought about rewards.
Later, I thought only about the next strike.
When my arms tired, I adjusted my movement.

ladder.zh: 身体不想动，我还是继续。
ladder.en: My body wanted to stop. I kept going.
At last, a message appeared.
Strength increased by one.
Just one point.
It had taken six hours.
You might laugh.

ladder.zh: 可我看着那个数字，真的很高兴。
ladder.en: But looking at that number, I was truly happy.
Nobody had given it to me.

ladder.zh: 是我一下、一下，练出来的。
ladder.en: I'd earned it, strike by strike.

ladder.zh: 后来，体力和敏捷也增加了。
ladder.en: Later, vitality and agility increased too.
My stomach, however, had its own opinion.

ladder.zh: 它不想听力量增加了多少。
ladder.en: It didn't care how much strength I'd gained.
It wanted food.
I opened my inventory.
Water, and ten rye breads.
A little food. A little water.
Then back to practice.
The people nearby started talking.
What was the point of hitting this thing?

ladder.zh: 出去打兔子，不是更好吗？
ladder.en: Wouldn't fighting rabbits be better?
I heard them.

ladder.zh: 可是，他们的话不能替我挥剑。
ladder.en: But their words couldn't swing my sword for me.
There was a knight called Pluto.
He knew this practice mattered.

ladder.zh: 现在多练一点，以后就会更强。
ladder.en: Train a little more now, and you'd be stronger later.
But it took a great deal of time.
For others, it was too slow.

ladder.zh: 对我来说，只要有用，就继续。
ladder.en: For me, if it worked, I'd keep going.
Three weeks passed.

ladder.zh: 我的身体，已经不一样了。
ladder.en: My body was different now.

ladder.zh: 力量，敏捷，体力，都在提高。
ladder.en: Strength, agility, vitality—all were improving.
The sword obeyed me more and more.
But my level was still one.

ladder.zh: 看等级的人，会以为我什么都没做。
ladder.en: Anyone looking at my level would think I'd done nothing.
Some progress is invisible to other people.
Later, the bread began running out.
I noticed the instructor's lunch.
Sword practice required effort.

ladder.zh: 想吃顿好饭，有时候也需要说话的本事。
ladder.en: Getting a good meal sometimes required skill with words.
I said some flattering things.
He was willing to share his meal.
Of course I was grateful.
My stomach was even more grateful.

ladder.zh: 那顿饭，后来带来了一个任务。
ladder.en: That meal eventually led to a quest.
But I didn't know that yet.

ladder.zh: 我只知道，今天比昨天强了一点。
ladder.en: I only knew I was a little stronger than yesterday.
The dummy was still there.
I raised my sword again.
One more strike.

title: The Price of Moonlight
objective: Weed recalls the promise behind the moonlight sculpture. Short Chinese phrases are followed by English. Narrated by Weed.

opening.zh: 我曾经花了一枚银币，买一个故事。
opening.en: Once, I paid a silver coin for a story.

ladder.zh: 直到现在，想起来还有点心疼。
ladder.en: Even now, remembering it hurts a little.

ladder.zh: 可是那个故事，我没有忘。
ladder.en: But I haven't forgotten that story.
It began with two silver coins.

ladder.zh: 教官让我调查一个传闻。
ladder.en: The instructor asked me to investigate a rumor.
Someone could carve moonlight.
My first thought, however, was bread.

ladder.zh: 两枚银币，能买六十六个面包。
ladder.en: Two silver coins could buy sixty-six loaves.
With change left over.

ladder.zh: 这么重要的事，当然要算清楚。
ladder.en: Naturally, something this important needed careful calculation.
I went to the sculpture shop.
The shopkeeper looked at my clothes.

ladder.zh: 他连问题都不想听，就让我走。
ladder.en: He told me to leave without hearing my question.
I slowly backed toward the door.

ladder.zh: 然后，看见了那只金色的双头鹰。
ladder.en: Then I noticed the golden two-headed eagle.
I began praising it.
At last, the shopkeeper's attitude changed.

ladder.zh: 他让我坐下，还给我蜂蜜水。
ladder.en: He offered me a seat, and honey water.

ladder.zh: 原来，有时候开门的不是钥匙。
ladder.en: Apparently, sometimes a key doesn't open the door.
A few pleasing words do.

ladder.zh: 他确认了月光雕刻的传闻。
ladder.en: He confirmed the rumor about carving moonlight.

ladder.zh: 还让我调查王后和雕刻师的过去。
ladder.en: He also asked me to investigate the queen and the sculptor.
So I went looking for a bard.

ladder.zh: 这次，好听的话不管用了。
ladder.en: This time, flattering words didn't work.

ladder.zh: 我拿出钱，却忘了先换零钱。
ladder.en: I took out money, forgetting to get smaller change first.

ladder.zh: 一枚银币，就这样到了他手里。
ladder.en: And just like that, a silver coin was in his hand.

ladder.zh: 我还没来得及心疼，他已经开始讲了。
ladder.en: Before I could mourn it properly, he'd begun his story.
The sculptor's name was Zahab.

ladder.zh: 他和后来的王后，从小就认识。
ladder.en: He and the future queen had known each other as children.

ladder.zh: 他用木头，雕刻她的样子。
ladder.en: He carved her likeness in wood.
She accepted the gift.
He also made a promise.

ladder.zh: 有一天，要送她世界上最美的雕像。
ladder.en: One day, he'd give her the world's most beautiful sculpture.
Later, she became queen.
They were separated.

ladder.zh: 我以为，这又是一个没有实现的约定。
ladder.en: I thought this was another unfulfilled promise.
But the bard said I was wrong.

ladder.zh: 她说，他后来的作品，是世界上最美的。
ladder.en: She'd called his later work the most beautiful in the world.

ladder.zh: 为了弄清楚，我去找老侍女。
ladder.en: To understand, I went to the elderly attendant.
She had witnessed that night herself.

ladder.zh: 扎哈布回来的时候，拿着一把剑。
ladder.en: When Zahab returned, he was carrying a sword.

ladder.zh: 不是小时候的雕刻小刀。
ladder.en: Not the carving knife from his childhood.
The queen was heartbroken.
She thought he'd forgotten.

ladder.zh: 对他来说，也许只是一句话。
ladder.en: Perhaps, to him, it had only been words.

ladder.zh: 对她来说，却是等了那么多年的约定。
ladder.en: To her, it was a promise she'd waited years for.
Then the assassins appeared.
They meant to kill the king and queen.
Zahab raised his sword.
The moonlight moved with it.
That sword wasn't merely a weapon.
In his hands, it could carve too.
He sang as he moved his sword.
Tears ran down the queen's face.
The assassins fled.
He hadn't forgotten his promise.

ladder.zh: 他只是用了她没想到的方法。
ladder.en: He'd fulfilled it in a way she hadn't imagined.

ladder.zh: 任务完成，我升到了三级。
ladder.en: The quest ended, and I rose to level three.

ladder.zh: 系统让我选择月光雕刻师。
ladder.en: The system offered me the Moonlight Sculptor class.
I refused. Twice.
Don't look at me like that.

ladder.zh: 月光很美，可我还得赚钱。
ladder.en: Moonlight was beautiful, but I still needed to earn money.
Then the attendant offered me gifts.

ladder.zh: 一把雕刻小刀，一个木头雕像。
ladder.en: A carving knife. A wooden statue.

ladder.zh: 还有一个，不能取消的任务。
ladder.en: And a quest that couldn't be cancelled.

ladder.zh: 我要找到扎哈布，学会他的歌。
ladder.en: I had to find Zahab and learn his song.

ladder.zh: 在她去世以前，回来唱给她听。
ladder.en: Then return and sing it before she died.
I looked at the little knife in my hand.

ladder.zh: 为了查一个传闻，我走到这里。
ladder.en: I'd come this far to investigate a rumor.

ladder.zh: 现在，别人的约定，落到了我手里。
ladder.en: Now someone else's promise rested in my hands.

ladder.zh: 有些礼物，收下才知道有多重。
ladder.en: Some gifts reveal their weight only after you accept them.
